newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Two die, power plant halted in Azeri downpour.
newsitem.headline: Two die, power plant halted in Azeri downpour.

text.p: Torrential rains in Azerbaijan killed two people and cut electricity supplies from the former Soviet Republic's main generating plant, Interfax news agency said on Friday.

It did not indicate how the two people died but it quoted a government source in the capital Baku as saying regions in the north and northwest of the country had received the equivalent of a month's rain on Thursday night and Friday morning.
The downpour badly damaged buildings, vehicles and communications and washed away livestock and sections of railway track, Interfax said.
The Caucasus republic's government has set up a special commission to help tackle the disaster, it added.
